name: Zhejiang Chunhui Intelligent Control Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Chunhui Intelligent Control Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells fluid control valve and control systems in China and internationally. The company offers oil and gas control products; gas control products; heating control products; and air conditioning control products. It also provides internal combustion engine accessories, including camshafts and thrust; and information system integration and technical services. Zhejiang Chunhui Intelligent Control Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shaoxing Chunhui Refrigeration Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhejiang Chunhui Intelligent Control Co., Ltd. in November 2001.
